items.name: OpenRouter 翻译（:free 模型池） / OpenRouter translation (:free model pool)
items.license: 官方 API，免费模型池需自备 Key / official API, key required for free pool
items.note: 字幕翻译的 OpenRouter 引擎调用 OpenRouter（openrouter.ai）的官方 OpenAI 兼容接口 POST /api/v1/chat/completions，并只使用模型 id 带 :free 后缀、pricing.prompt 为 0 的免费模型（候选池在运行时从公开的 /api/v1/models 列表发现，免费额度由各家上游 provider 提供）。需要用户在 openrouter.ai 免费注册并自备 API Key —— 免费模型同样需要鉴权，本应用不内置任何 Key。本应用与 OpenRouter 无关联、未获授权与背书；免费模型的可用性、速率限制与定价由 OpenRouter 及上游 provider 单方决定、可能随时变化（命中限流时本应用会给该模型单独冷却并自动换用池内其它模型）。启用时字幕文本会发送至 OpenRouter 及其上游 provider，请勿翻译敏感内容。 / The OpenRouter engine calls OpenRouter's official OpenAI-compatible endpoint (POST /api/v1/chat/completions) and uses only free models whose id ends with ':free' and whose prompt price is 0 (the candidate pool is discovered at runtime from the public /api/v1/models list; the free allowance is provided by each upstream provider). A user-supplied API key from a free openrouter.ai account is required — free models are still authenticated and this app ships no key. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenRouter; availability, rate limits and pricing of free models are set unilaterally by OpenRouter and its upstream providers and may change at any time (on rate limiting the app cools down that single model and rotates to another model in the pool). Subtitle text is sent to OpenRouter and its upstream providers — do not translate sensitive content.
